title: Ray J Sounds Off-On Kris Jenner Comments About Her Age, And She Wants Kanye West To Stop Online Rants In Jenner-Kardashian's Direction
htmlContent:
Following another online rant from Kanye West against the Kardashian family and Pete Davidson, Kim Kardashian's former Ray J is joining in without calling out the family.

Following Kanye West's yet another online battle against the Kardashian family and Pete Davidson, Kim Kardashian's ex boyfriend Ray J is calling the family. This time the rapper had his eyes set on momager Kris Jenner as he wrote about the "fake stories" she put in the media to control the stories against him after he allegedly leaked the tape he had made with his girlfriend at the time, Kim Kardashian.

Ray J joined in with West criticism as he posted on Instagram of Yeezy's founder, who shared screenshots of one of the Kardashian begging the rapper to stop his online ramblings as Mom Jenner approaches age 67 and her online explosions are stressing her out for "never-ending."

According to Page Six, Ray J wrote, “What about my mom Kris? You tell people false stories about me, making the black man look horrible, for your gain, you introduced me to Steve HIRSH, you masterminded everything for your family, and tried to ruin me at the same time smh — you don't think all mothers get stressed? Or you special huh?” 

“I know it’s old and I don’t care — this makes me sick — but God had my back and still does,” he concluded.
